contradictions.why: A says the vizier's sister's son (nephew) was killed, while B says the vizier's brother's son (nephew) was killed.

contradictions.b: الْمُتَوَكِّلُ عَلَى تَأْيِيدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَحْسَنَ شَاهِ السُّلْطَانِ
contradictions.why: The inscription on the coin is completely different in B compared to A.

additions.b: الْمُتَوَكِّلُ عَلَى تَأْيِيدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَحْسَنَ شَاهِ السُّلْطَانِ
